checks: real source members
all important regional stars retained
complete minor arcs and members inside current territory
same seed reproduces independently of source order
different seeds change selected members
expanded manual territory and untouched neighbours
sparse, disconnected and empty territories
no alternative and neighbour member conflict

successive regional draws vary; undo, redo and cancel restore complete candidate states
confirmation is temporary until explicitly starred; starred regenerated figures and notes survive reload
editing a favourite creates a new unstarred result without altering or duplicating the saved original

unfavouriting removes local retention immediately while keeping the currently displayed result usable
manual regions with previously enlarged borders resample against their actual current territory
reproducing the same seed as a favourite yields a temporary result and leaves the favourite intact
regional regeneration and confirmation controls fit a 390px candidate window

zero favourites, cancelling the last favourite, built-in initial view and reload all remain usable

independentAudit.scope: Read-only review of favourite retention, migration, regional generation and editor state isolation
independentAudit.finding: Truthy nonboolean imported favourite values could be retained
independentAudit.resolution: Only boolean true counts as a favourite; three targeted browser checks passed after repair

initialBrowserAttempt.cause: History position from the preceding editing session was reused after starting a fresh editor
initialBrowserAttempt.resolution: Corrected the test helper and reran the complete 13-check browser flow successfully

guarantees: Only explicit favourites are persisted, including after migration and import
New confirmed or generated results remain temporary until explicitly favourited
Saved originals and their metadata survive edits as separate records
Regional generation samples against the current actual territory, including draft boundary edits
All boundaries and other constellations are preserved
Regional drafts support repeated regeneration, undo, redo, confirm and cancel
Manual-3 stores final members and edges for deterministic replay
limitations: Constellation selection is a cultural design heuristic, not a unique physical prediction
Small candidate pools may not offer a different combination; the current draft is retained and the user is informed
Regional generation keeps the current territory and does not repartition the sky
The ownership grid remains one degree and manual-3 containment rules remain in effect
Persistence was tested in isolated browser storage; existing user storage migrates when the new page loads
No automatic draw algorithm was changed; the previously known slow draw-9 seed was not retested
scope: Independent constellation workbench, regional sampler, documentation and checks; source stars, historical samples and formal V1/V2 renderers preserved
